label: Create a segment
description: Save a segment: a set of contacts that match rules, kept up to date by Brevo. The public API has no route for this. The rules are set in the web app's filter editor. This entry does not define the rule format, because the request body was not captured. Do not use it to build a segment with rules without a browser agent that follows ui_steps, and check the contact count in the web app before you report success.
intent_examples: make a segment of contacts who signed up in the last 30 days
save these filters as a segment

template.description: Optional template from the 'Create a segment' page, for example 'New email contacts'; otherwise filters are added one by one

ui_steps: Pick 'Create segment from scratch' or a template
Type the name, keep or pick the folder, click 'Create'

postcondition.assert: the list holds a segment with this name. This does not prove the rules are right: the public read returns the name and folder only

verification.notes: Done in the web app; the internal call and the public read-back were captured. The internal request body was not captured, so the undocumented route is a pointer, not a ready call.

sources.ref: sources/ui/areas-2026-10-30.yaml (Segments: create, edit and delete exist only in the web app)
